description: University Grants Commission - Institute of Human Resource  Advancement (IHRA) Ordinance under Section 18 of the Universities  Act No. 16 of 1978
categorisation: This gazette content contains an ordinance made by the University Grants Commission under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, which amends the Institute of Human Resource Advancement Ordinance. It deals with legal/regulatory matters including amendments to existing legislation, academic degree regulations, and examination procedures, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
